name: Skyro
h1: Taking the playbook to new markets
lede: Skyro is taking its Philippine digital lending playbook to Malaysia first, broadening into a multi-product financial ecosystem and scaling its merchant network responsibly. Airtable gives the teams behind each launch one connected way to run the work.
why_h2: A second country, a new brand and a fast-growing network
why_p: Market entry, merchant growth and a brand refresh all add cross-team work that has to be tracked consistently.

signals.title: Malaysian moneylender's licence secured
signals.body: Skyro's Malaysian entity obtained a moneylender's licence from the Ministry of Housing and Local Government.
signals.angle: A second country implies a repeatable launch checklist: one template, tracked per market.

signals.title: Merchant network grows more than fivefold
signals.body: Loan disbursements in the Philippines more than doubled in 2025 and the online merchant network grew more than fivefold, with products offered through 3,000+ merchants and about 10,000 retail locations.
signals.angle: Partner onboarding at this scale needs one connected tracker for merchants, locations and status.

signals.title: Responsible digital lending at ASEAN Tech Summit
signals.body: Skyro presented on responsible digital lending at ASEAN Tech Summit Manila 2026.
signals.angle: Responsible lending commitments are easier to evidence when controls and actions are tracked in one place.

signals.title: Refreshed identity as a multi-product ecosystem
signals.body: Skyro refreshed its visual identity as it repositions as an international multi-product financial ecosystem, with 7 million+ users and a credit portfolio above USD 200 million.
signals.angle: Brand and product rollouts span design, product and marketing: run them on one shared programme view.
